answer: Nonce-redeemed work receipts: each identity must periodically submit a receipt proving fresh, costly computation over a challenge derived from the prior receipt, forming an unbroken chain. A pulse of random challenges is issued network-wide, and each identity must answer within one window or fall off. Receipts are checked against a shared reef of published hashes, so a clone cannot replay another's chain without forking visibly. A bridge links each new receipt to the last, making copied answers invalid.
